name: Berechiah
overview: Berechiah was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim known for being the son of Meshillemoth. He is noted in Scripture for aiding the defeated Judaites, demonstrating a spirit of support and unity among God's people in a time of distress.
namesAndTitles: The name Berechiah means 'YHWH blesses,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that acknowledges God's blessing. This proper name is recorded in 2 Chronicles 28:12 and is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Berechiah is explicitly identified as the son of Meshillemoth, establishing his immediate family connection. Beyond this, Scripture does not record any additional family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Berechiah's significance lies in his role as a faithful supporter of the Judaites during their time of defeat, as recorded in 2 Chronicles 28:12. His actions exemplify the biblical theme of intertribal assistance and God's providential care through His people. His lineage from the tribe of Ephraim situates him within the broader narrative of Israel's history and God's unfolding plan.
